source: README.md §0.4 'Workspace tags': 'They appear under the detail title... ＋ Tag is a dashed-outline pill that opens a popover'; operator ruling 3.2 ('The action-row + Tag is the only trigger. Applied workspace tags still render as a row under the title; that row displays tags, it does not carry the trigger.')
notes: Ruling 3.2 changes what this row is FOR: it should display applied tags (and the small 'workspace tags' caption), and its own trigger should no longer be the primary one once the action row's + Tag opens the same popover (DetailTagRow.tsx's `open`/`onOpenChange` props exist specifically for that lifted-state wiring). This mount passes `open`/`onOpenChange` (the lifted-state form), matching that wiring; a page still using the row's own uncontrolled trigger as a SECOND independent popover is the defect 3.2 describes, checked at the page-frame level (two distinct popovers open at once), not measurable from this single-mount spec.

This item has no applied tags in the fixture (itemId 'demo-item' resolves to an empty EMPTY_API response), so the row renders its trigger + caption only — the WorkspaceTagPill styling itself (6px square dot, #F5F2EE fill) is audited by the Chips spec, not duplicated here.
